description: Pause an outbound call campaign. Stops its queued and scheduled calls and cancels pending call attempts; a call already in progress may finish. Leads are kept and the campaign can be resumed later with launch_call_campaign. Needs campaign_id, the calls:write scope and an admin role in the business. Pausing an already paused campaign changes nothing.

business_id.description: Business ID. Required when the token can reach more than one business.

name: pause_call_campaign
title: Pause Call Campaign
